steps.title: Configure Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the Smart Business Manager Pro metadata, setting the package identifier to com.smartbusinessmanager.app.

steps.title: Set Up Android Build System
steps.description: Establish build configurations inside build.gradle targeting compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java 8 compilation compatibility.

steps.title: Define Application Manifest Rules
steps.description: Set application theme, launcher activity, permissions, and app title in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create SQLite Database Helper Class
steps.description: Program DatabaseHelper.java to manage tables for products, customers, sales, sale items, expenses, and system settings.

steps.title: Build Canvas-Based Custom Chart View
steps.description: Develop a lightweight custom View in CustomChartView.java to display sales and expenses comparison with Canvas draw techniques.

steps.title: Design Core XML Application Layout
steps.description: Compose activity_main.xml layout structuring a material dashboard, tab switcher buttons, modules, search tools, and widgets.

steps.title: Initialize MainActivity Lifecycle and Views
steps.description: Bind top-bar, menu elements, dialog hooks, navigation buttons, and tab switchers inside MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Stats Calculator
steps.description: Code business analytics methods querying outstanding balances, sales/expenses totals, profit, low-stock count, and latest logs.

steps.title: Create Product Inventory System
steps.description: Write product management features allowing addition, SKU setup, category matching, editing, deleting, and automatic stock alerts.

steps.title: Develop Customer Ledger System
steps.description: Code ledger tools capturing phone numbers, addresses, sales histories, paid ratios, and outstanding bills.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Sales Cart Engine
steps.description: Program interactive cart controls that check inventory limits, apply custom discounts or taxes, and handle sales lists.

steps.title: Develop Invoice Generation & Stock Depletion Engine
steps.description: Program checkout engines generating custom invoice previews, committing DB entries, and reducing product stock quantities.

steps.title: Create Expense Records Tracker
steps.description: Write methods to register operational bills, categorize expenses, track dates, and aggregate daily/monthly totals.

steps.title: Write Custom Canvas Chart Data Binders
steps.description: Construct reporting algorithms feeding sales indicators and operational overheads to the CustomChartView.

steps.title: Implement Global Search and Notifications
steps.description: Code search terms matches for items, shoppers, sales, and bills, with popups summarizing critical operations.

steps.title: Create Configuration Settings Controller
steps.description: Write operational variables configurations like currency symbols, tax rates, business titles, and dark-mode toggles.

steps.title: Building Smart Business Manager Pro
steps.description: Perform sanity audits on XML schemas and trigger the final build verification for Smart Business Manager Pro.
